name: croc_top_c
description: Saltwater crocodile seen from directly above, bent into a C (banana) curve for the death-roll diagram: head curved to the top-right, tail curving to the bottom-right, body bulging left; legs folded flat against the sides; rows of square scutes down the back and a double crest on the tail; two yellow eyes on top of the head, nostril knob at the snout tip. Mid-tone olive on a black outline so it reads on dark slate #2a3040. Anchor centre; bbox x -155..155, y -296..282.
